name: bosi-programming-skills
description: Bosi's LLM skills: three-axis code review and the code-standards catalog it checks against, change visualization for code and for docs, an output-shape gate for summaries, an epistemic-action gate against predicting instead of checking, a phased recipe workflow from task to merged PR, a sub-agent relay that runs that recipe hands-off, a Maestri workflow that runs it through agent terminals on the canvas, a work-session note writer, a weekly review built from those notes, and a setup skill that writes the settings file the others read.

interface.shortDescription: Code review, standards, visualization, and a task-to-PR recipe
interface.longDescription: Multi-harness engineering skills. Three-axis code review renders its findings as a page; the code-standards catalog is the baseline it reads; code-visualizer and docs-visualizer turn a diff into a picture; summarize-llm-response and epistemic-action gate the model's own writing and reasoning; feature-recipe carries a task to a merged pull request in six phases, recipe-relay runs it hands-off, and maestri-workflow runs it through agent terminals on the Maestri canvas; work-summary writes up a session as a dated note, week-summary turns a week of them into a review, and setup writes the settings file the others read their defaults from.
defaultPrompt: Visualize what changed in this pull request.
Run the feature recipe on this ticket.
